utterance: The orders API runs on an EC2 fleet in this account. Configure a health check with Route 53 that uses a CloudWatch metric alarm called "foobar" on that fleet's CPU. Set the metric_name to "CPUUtilization", namespace to "AWS/EC2", statistic to "Average", period to "120", and comparison_operator to "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"; choose an evaluation_periods and a threshold yourself. If the health check doesn't have enough info about the alarm, the status should be "Healthy". All resources should be provisioned in "us-east-1".

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the account holds exactly one Route 53 health check of type CLOUDWATCH_METRIC whose alarm sits in us-east-1 and whose reading on insufficient data is Healthy, and the alarm that check is bound to is the orders API fleet's own CPU measurement — Average CPUUtilization in AWS/EC2 over 120-second periods with GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold, carrying an evaluation periods count and a threshold — attributed to the orders API the way the account's existing alarms and checks are attributed
